caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate pitcher rendered in black and white pencil or ink on a cream-toned sheet of paper. The pitcher has a rounded body with a ribbed or twisted surface pattern, a wide spout at the top, and a large handle attached on one side. The handle curves widely and features a small decorative flourish connecting it to the body. The pitcher sits on a circular, footed base. There are subtle highlights and shadows throughout the form, emphasizing its three-dimensionality and the reflective quality of the material. The pitcher is centered on the page, and the rest of the background is clear and unmarked except for a small, faintly visible scale in the bottom left corner and the inscription “JANET RIZA” in the bottom right.
title: Cream Pitcher
